title: What Made Me Feverish With Passion

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
It was the first time I'd seen Festa run
since she graduated. She used to take my
father's running lessons for Umamusume,
so I thought I knew what she was like on
the track.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
I could hardly believe what I was seeing,
but at the same time, she
was still up to
her same old antics—even as a new Tracen
student.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
You see, a wildly famous Umamusume was
visiting from France, and
somehow Festa
got into a one-on-one race with her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
From what I heard, the French
Umamusume didn't really consider Festa
an opponent. The freestyle course's grass
reminded her of home, so she only issued
the challenge for a chance to run.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
But none of the freestyle racers milling
about wanted to accept a challenge they'd
surely lose. This was a high-level racing
star, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, her physique and skills were a
cut above. If the street racers were to
contest that in good faith,
all it would do is crush their
confidence. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah. Hahaha! Go ahead, get all
complacent. I'll make you... regret it!

text_block_list.name: French Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah! ...Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Festa made her opponent take her
seriously. A racer so obscenely 
experienced compared to herself. And
Festa just egged her on with that gleam in
her eyes... and the biggest smile.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhgh, shut up! Shut up, shut UP! I can't
hear anything over how
loud my heart's
pounding! Haha, I feel so...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So alive!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Festa lost in the end, but she had her
claws around the world's neck, if only for
an instant. She ran herself ragged, then
collapsed right past
the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
I imagine she'd been held up by adrenaline
alone, so the fatigue
caught up all at once. But she did it.
A pre-debut street racer, up 
against a world-class Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, sorry... I got a little too excited there. Cough... cough... Haaah... Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Please give her a place where she
feels alive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
When she was younger, she was always
darting into alleys, getting herself into
danger. She and her troublemaker friends
would take all
kinds of risks, just for the
cheap thrill of it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
But the adrenaline high from those games
never lasted long. Deep
down, what she
really longs for is...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Races—competitions where she can let her
instincts run wild. I believe
that's the only
place where she'll truly be able to set
her heart free.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I head home, I keep thinking about the
video I just saw. Nakayama Festa's running
was completely different from what I saw
at the
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And I finally understand what the
difference is. Everything comes
down to
whether the stakes get her fired up or
not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The opponent was leagues above her in
skill. Ten out of ten people would've
called the odds impossible... But that's
what she likes—the
"what if."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So if we can find a way to up the ante of
her races... maybe she'll
have that outlet
she's been craving—a place where she
feels alive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, another thought sinks in like a gulp
of saliva down a dry throat.
I try to force it through,
but... it's just a wild fantasy. It's
unrealistic, and I have no proof it could
work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's got the potential to take on the
world. If I can draw out the
sleeping talent
none of the instructors could,
then I might really train
up a global star!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That evening, I get permission from Miho
Dorm's leader to stake out
the entryway in
hopes of catching Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, are you—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that I'm the one she saved at
the pier, and with a motion at my trainer
badge, I let her know that I saw her
performance at the
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, that'd explain why the stranger
staking out the dorm looked familiar. So
what's your deal? Here to give me your
lofty trainer opinion on why I should take
my running more seriously?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's! ...So you met Teach, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That race was a one-time thing. Just a
lucky fluke. And if you paid attention at
the tryouts, you'd know it. I don't have
another race like
that in me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
At the rate I'm going, I might bomb all my
debut chances and get the boot without a
single win.
All 'cause I'm actin' like a brat
who's too cool to care about newbie races.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's looking for risks and thrills,
then
I've just got to add
challenges to her
races—and make sure she can't back out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Win big or lose big.
Earn everyone's praise
or deal with their
contempt. That's all a
competition really needs to come down to.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Nakayama Festa and I
sneak into a press conference where
they're interviewing El Condor Pasa, a
member of the "Golden Generation" of
racers.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa seized the glory of second
place at the world-renowned Prix de l'Arc
de Triomphe, and has been taking an

extended break since.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Yep. I spent some time looking for a
runner I could pass the mask on to... but
y'know what? I'm not throwin' in the towel
yet! I'm gonna get back out there and
prove I'm the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I've been cookin' up plans
for a looong tour! If all
goes well, I can get
the ball rolling as early as next yea—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uh, rude. Right now, we're discussing the
future of the world's strongest
Umamusume. You just jumped into the ring
and challenged the champ. You know what
that means, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It means that I'm gonna beat you
and take those world tour
plans for myself,
El.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You already had your match with the
global stars, and you lost. But
I've got the
potential to ride the new tour to the top.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You want me to challenge El? The one who placed in the Arc? And you want my pre-debut ass to do it in front of all the reporters?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we shoot our mouths off, the media's
definitely gonna gobble the drama up. It's
a debut race with a world career on the
line, where neither runner can afford to
lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Nakayama pulls it off, she instantly
becomes a global sensation. If she fails,
she's the laughing stock of the world.
Either way, it'll affect
how she's viewed for
the rest of her career.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. The chance to score a cushy career
for free would get anyone excited. But
odds are, El's just gonna kick my ass and
that's the end of
me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I make a bad impression at my debut
race, it tells everyone that I'm
not worth
training. You know that could be
career-ending, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Haha, well played. I'm the one that
egged you on at that
chicken race, huh?
I've gotta take my own advice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's decide who deserves those career
plans, El. If you're in, we'll
handle the rest
on our end. I've got a real debut race to
prep for once I beat you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're callin' a match with me practice for your debut?! I can't believe you. You don't know what it's really like to take on the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I can't let you get away with all that
smack talk, or you'll have other people
underestimating overseas races too. Now...
Failure,
humiliation, or despair—which'll it be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand that's how we signed ourselves up
for the gamble of a
lifetime.
